name: Jin-Gitaxias
description: Jin-Gitaxias is a Phyrexian praetor, scientist and inventor who serves Elesh Norn, and who compleated Tamiyo and built Tezzeret's darksteel body.

summary.text: Jin-Gitaxias is a Phyrexian praetor, scientist and inventor who serves Elesh Norn, and who compleated Tamiyo and built Tezzeret's darksteel body.

bio.text: He joined Elesh Norn's effort to create Atraxa, and is described as the monster who murdered Tameshi.
He led the lab operation on Kamigawa, sending ninjas after Kaito, and the Wanderer cleaved him with her sword while freeing Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Jin-Gitaxias advises Norn otherwise, she tears off his arm; he retreats and prepares his war machine with a vat of newts.
timeline.quote: she tore off his arm.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final battle Jin-Gitaxias orders his army to kill Norn, but Zhalfirin forces collapse his war machine and his newts devour him.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A newly ascended Elspeth intervenes as Jin-Gitaxias is about to cut down Koth.
timeline.quote: Just as Jin-Gitaxias was to cut down Koth, a newly ascended Elspeth intervened, healing some of the Mirrans and giving them new resolve.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain.
timeline.quote: In the battle that followed, Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret obtains his darksteel body but escapes to Esper before Jin-Gitaxias can compleat him.

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
